name: Nakosoji Airi
source:
Mamiya's eldest daughter. Identical twin sister to Rin. A junior at the school Amehiko once attended. Top student in her grade.

Quiet personality, the quintessential well-bred young lady type. Doesn't speak much. A virgin.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=29165&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
